scripts.build:menu: bun run --filter frontend-menu build && bun scripts/generate-precache-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:all: bun run build:menu & bun run build:admin & wait
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd backend && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply live_menu --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cd backend && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply live_menu --remote --env=production
scripts.deploy: bun run build:all && bun run deploy:worker && bun run deploy:pages && bun run deploy:admin && bun run deploy:notify
